docs/33 · proposal for Diogo · 2026-10-15, revised 2026-10-15 after review · issues #69 and #72 · v1 and v2 stay frozen

Servers in any state

With two servers and the current one empty, the library shows no rail, so the only visible way to the other server is gone. This board looks at every place a server can be switched today, what each one shows when the server is empty, unreachable, refusing its sign-in or full, and proposes one rule: with two servers or more, a way to the others is always on screen, whatever state the current one is in. §7 takes the same question into the add sheet (#72): which server a torrent goes to, and whether you can change it there.

§1 and §2 are real screenshots. §3 onwards are mocks at base 14 in Theme roles; use the theme switch for them. Names and counts in the mocks are the manual box's (public: 0 torrents, private: 4), plus a third server, "seedbox", with a wrong password.

revised 2026-10-15 · after Diogo's review
  1. One server: "they never see the server options, right?" Right. §8 now says so place by place, checked against the app. One correction: today the add sheet names the server in its foot with one server too. D19, D20.
  2. The rail's servers: pinned to the bottom of the rail, outside its scroll, on a band of their own, foldable to one line, with rules for short windows and base sizes. §9, D16–D18; D12 changes, D1 follows.
  3. Errors: every place one reaches the screen today, with shots, and one pattern: plain words first, naming the server or torrent; the technical text behind "details"; one or two actions; a rule for where each kind goes. §10, D21–D23; D8, D9 and D15 now use it.
  4. Tray and widget together: one menu, built once in the app, shown by the tray and by the widget's popup, servers included, so choosing the widget loses nothing; the docs/20 changes it needs. §11, D24, D25; D10 changes.

D1–D15 keep their numbers; the ones that changed carry revised in §13 with what changed. New shots 27–35: omabox (Omarchy 4.0.4-1, Hyprland 0.56.2, 1920×1080, theme baseline, base 14), commit 9f8ba03, one server ("box", the box's own qBittorrent 5.2.3), the bar widget on.

theme
1 · where we are

Today: the rail is the only switch you can see, and an empty library hides it

  1. An empty library hides the whole rail, its SERVERS group with it (MainView: the rail shows only when !libraryEmpty && !firstSync). With "public" empty, nothing on screen leads to "private". Settings › Servers d ("make default") is the one way left, and its footer doesn't name d.
  2. A click on an empty server in the rail is a one-way door. The rail goes with the click, so the way back is gone too.
  3. No other way in. No key, no command in : ("serv" finds "details larger"), nothing in the jump palette, the hero, the tray, the bar widget, the ⋯ menu or the ? sheet.
  4. The empty states disagree. An empty server that is unreachable or refuses its sign-in shows the rail, full of zeros, with an empty table and "no torrent selected". The same server when it answers shows no rail at all.
  5. Wording. A refused sign-in reads "seedbox · unreachable"; the footer prints "last sync" with no time; ctrl+b and ⋯ "hide rail" act on a rail that isn't there, and the hidden state carries to the next server.

Real screenshots, commit 9d1858b (0.2.0 + Unreleased), in an omabox (Omarchy 4.0.4, Hyprland 0.56.2, 1920×1080, theme baseline, base 14): the manual box, with omaseed installed and two qBittorrent 5.2.3. Full set in .local/docs/evidence/issue-69/.

One thing the app can't know today: it talks to one server at a time. setDefaultServer stops the sync engine and starts it on the next one; nothing polls the others. Anything that shows another server's state needs either a remembered figure or a probe (D5).
3 · the empty library, two servers or more

Keep a way to the others on screen

Three ways to do it. All three keep v2's Fig. 22 as the body; they differ in where the servers sit.

4 · a switch from anywhere

One server palette: a key, the hero's server line, and :

The rail fixes the empty library, but it's last in a long rail and hidden by ctrl+b. A small palette, built from Kit/Palette like the sort and category palettes, lists every server and switches on enter. Three ways open it: ctrl+s (D2), a click on the hero's server line (D3), and "switch server…" in : (D4).

Why ctrl+s: switching server is app-level, and omaseed's ctrl keys are the app-level ones (ctrl+k jump, ctrl+, settings). s is sort, and capitals mean a stronger variant, which a server switch isn't. Without SUPER, Omarchy binds nothing on ctrl+s, and omaseed has nothing to save, so the reflex costs nothing. Settings › qBittorrent's own s (next server) stays.

6 · outside the window

The tray, Settings' wording, and where SERVERS sits

Where SERVERS sits when there are torrents (D12) revised 2026-10-15

Was: last in the scroll, as today. After review: pinned to the bottom of the rail, outside its scroll, on a band of its own and foldable. §9 draws the options; filters still come first, and the servers are on screen whatever the scroll.

Adding a server, and first run

Adding a server keeps you where you are, as today; E1's row and the Servers footer now say how to go there. First run's done line stays ("add it later in Settings › Servers"). ctrl+b and ⋯ "hide rail" act on E1's rail like any other, so they stop flipping a setting you can't see.

The bar widget revised 2026-10-15

Was out of scope. Now in: §11 gives the tray and the widget one menu, servers included, with the docs/20 changes it needs. Still out: two servers on screen at once; omaseed stays one server at a time.

7 · the add sheet (#72)

Which server a torrent goes to, and changing it there

A magnet or a .torrent opens the add sheet over whatever server the app is on. The sheet says which one only in the foot's dim right corner ("server: private", footerRight; with one server too, shot 28), and nothing in it can change it. omaseed holds one connection at a time (DECISIONS C8), so "add it to the other server" means switching the app to it, and everything in the sheet that came from the first server has to follow.

Not proposed: an add that goes to another server while the app stays on this one. It needs a second connection (another client, its own sign-in, its own categories and paths), which C8 rules out; switching is the honest version of it, and the library you land on shows the torrent you just added.

With one server, nothing switches servers or offers to

Diogo asked: with only one server, the user never sees the server options in the rail, nor the new server choice in the add sheet, right? Right. Every proposal on this board starts at two servers. This section spells the one-server case out, place by place, and checks it against the app as it is (omabox, one server "box", commit 9f8ba03). One thing the board had wrong: the add sheet names the server in its foot with one server too.

The rule, one sentence: the server's name stays where it identifies the library (the hero, the window title, the tray tooltip, the widget head, a notice about it) and goes from wherever it only answers "which one?", a question one server never raises. Adding a second server turns every switch on at once; removing it turns them off again.
9 · the rail's servers new 2026-10-15

Pinned to the bottom, on a band of their own, foldable

Diogo: the servers in the left menu should be bottom aligned and fixed, not part of the rail's scroll; maybe with a different look; maybe collapsible. Below: today, two looks, folded, a switcher-only variant, and a short window at base 18. Each rail is 440 px at base 14 (R5: 330 px at base 18) and holds private's library: its filters need more than the height, so the scroll area shows its counted hint.

Where and how it looks

  • Under the rail's scroll area, outside it: the Flickable ends at the block's hairline, and the scroll hint's "▾ N more" sits above that hairline.
  • Theme roles only: hairline Theme.fill(0.12), band Theme.fill(0.04), current row 0.18, cursor 0.08. Dots: green live and answering, red down or refused, muted for the others' remembered "fine".
  • Rows are Kit RailRows with the dot in the glyph column, so heights follow Theme.railRowHeight at every base size.
  • Empty library (E1): the rail is the block alone, at the bottom where it always is. The first torrent fills the space above it; the block doesn't move.

Folding and keys

  • Folded: one row, "● NAME ▴ N servers". Heading click, z on the heading or any server row, enter on the folded line.
  • Remembered app-wide in state.json, not per server as the filter groups are: the block is the same on every server. Open the first time.
  • j k walk from the last filter row into the block; G lands on the last server; enter switches.
  • ctrl+b hides the whole rail, block included; the hero's ▾ and ctrl+s remain.

Short windows, base sizes, many servers

  • The rule counts rows, not pixels: the filters keep at least 5 rows. That holds at base 11 and at 18 alike.
  • Open, the block lists 5 servers at most; past that a sixth row, "… N more · ctrl+s", opens S1.
  • Narrow windows (docs/10, docs/15): where the rail gives way, the block goes with it; the hero's ▾ and ctrl+s stay.
10 · errors new 2026-10-15

One way to say something went wrong

Diogo: the "connection refused" message, and the other ones, should have a better UI; the current one is not well integrated. Below, every place an error reaches the screen today, word for word, then one pattern for all of them.

surfacetoday, word for wordshotwhat's wrong
window banner"✕ connection refused · retrying in 3 s · retry now settings"34b, 17no server named; Qt's words lower-cased; "3 s" here and "every 10 s" in the notice, for the same retry
hero server line"BOX · UNREACHABLE", also for a refused sign-in21the wrong word for a refusal (D9)
desktop notice"box is unreachable" / "127.0.0.1:8090 · connection refused · retrying every 10 s"34cthe best of them: the server, the address, what happens next
add sheet"POST torrents/add: Connection refused"26the request and Qt's words; no server named; nothing to do but cancel
Settings › Servers, test"not reachable · network: GET app/version: Connection refused"33kind, request and Qt's words in one line; no hint what to check
footer note (table actions)"location failed: conflict (409): POST torrents/setLocation: Error transferring http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/v2/torrents/setLocation - server replied: Conflict"29four layers of technical text; doesn't say which torrent or why; runs into the key hints; gone in seconds
keys stopped by the read-only guardnothing (p on a lost server)—silent
backup import rowsuntil #71: "unknown (415)"; now "qBittorrent couldn't read the .torrent of …"CHANGELOGthe fix found plain words; the pattern makes that the rule
bar widget popup"unreachable · connection refused · retrying in 8 s" / "Showing the last known state. Press r to retry now." / Retry35closest to a pattern already: a headline, what you're looking at, one button
a torrent's error (details)board 28: the cause, the fix, the log line—already the pattern for one torrent; left as it is

The pattern: a notice, the same everywhere (D21)

  • A headline in plain words that names the subject, a server or a torrent, and what didn't happen: "private didn't answer", "Field Recordings wasn't moved".
  • One line under it: what omaseed does next, or what you can change. "omaseed tries again in 7 s." "qBittorrent can't create or write that folder."
  • One or two actions that fix or route around it: retry now, switch server, edit login, set location again. Settings only when the fix is there.
  • "details ▸" folds the technical text: the kind and HTTP status, the request, qBittorrent's and Qt's own words, when, and how many tries. copy takes it for an issue. Nothing is hidden; it's just not the first thing you read.
  • Kinds keep Kit/Banner's marks: red rule and ✕ for an error, yellow and ! for a warning (something waits, nothing is lost), accent for information.

The words (D23)

what happenedheadlinethe line under itdetails keep
connection refused"NAME didn't answer""Nothing is listening at ADDRESS." + the retrykind, request, Qt's text, tries
host not found"NAME couldn't be found""ADDRESS doesn't resolve on this computer."the same
timeout"NAME is taking too long""No answer in N s." + the retrythe same
certificateQ27's words, as built (certificateRefusedText)the fingerprints
401, sign-in"NAME refused the sign-in""The username or password is wrong." / "The API key is wrong." (credentialRefusedText)the request, the status
403"NAME refused omaseed""Too many failed sign-ins, or this computer's address is banned in its Web UI settings."the same
409 on setLocation"NAME wasn't moved""qBittorrent can't create or write FOLDER."the same
415 on add"qBittorrent couldn't read the .torrent of NAME""The other torrents went in." (C9)the same
5xx"NAME had an internal error""qBittorrent answered N; its log may say why." + "open the log"the same
can't parse"NAME answered something omaseed can't read""Is ADDRESS a qBittorrent Web UI?"the first bytes
anything else"NAME refused: qBittorrent's own text"what was asked, in wordseverything

One retry figure: the banner and the desktop notice read the same timer (Q16: the engine's 10 s after an error; the banner's countdown shows what is left of it).

Where each kind goes (D22)

  • A server's problem (down, refused, certificate): the notice under the hero. One at a time.
  • Something you're doing in a sheet: in the sheet, above its buttons. The sheet stays open with what you typed.
  • An action from the table or a key: the footer, one sentence with "details"; the notice opens above the footer.
  • A torrent's own error: its details, board 28, unchanged.
  • While you're not looking (server lost or back): a desktop notice, the same headline (Q16 keeps them to that).

What it takes

  • core/ErrorWords: ApiError + the request + the subject (server or torrent name) → headline, line, details. Pure Qt, a QtTest per row of the table above.
  • Kit/Notice.qml: kind, title, body, actions ({label, key}, as Banner's), details, detailsOpen; tst_Notice.qml. Kit/Banner stays for one-line information (alternative limits, a burst).
  • Views: DisconnectedBanner → a Notice; AddSheet's and ServerSheet's error lines → Notice; the footer note gains a kind and the details it opens; the read-only guard's note.
11 · tray and widget new 2026-10-15

One menu, in the tray and in the widget, so choosing the widget loses nothing

Diogo: the tray setting should be rethought so its options appear even if you use the widget; they walk hand in hand. Today the tray icon hides while the widget runs (docs/20 Q7, trayIconMode auto), and the widget's popup carries much more than the tray, but not all of it: the stop and start all, quit and, with D10, the servers live only in the tray. This board ruled the widget out of scope; it's in now.

What docs/20 has to change for D24 a

  1. §1, Round 4: "No start/stop buttons" stays for buttons; stop all and start all are rows of the shared menu. p/P stay unbound; no per-torrent start or stop anywhere in the widget.
  2. docs/07 §1, "No quit": quit is the menu's last row, after a separator, as in the tray. A row two clicks deep is not the footgun a bar button was.
  3. §3, head: a fourth icon button, ⋯, opens the shared menu; the server line gets ▾ with two servers or more and opens the servers part (W1, W2).
  4. §3, keys: ctrl+. the menu, ctrl+s the servers, the app's own keys for the same things.
  5. §5, read: status.json gains, within v2 under board 31 D12's rule (additive, v stays 2): servers, a list of {id, name, current, state (ok · down · refused · first-sync · unknown), count, seen, reason}, and menu, a list of {id, label, kind (action · check · radio · caption · separator), checked, enabled}. A widget that doesn't know them shows today's popup.
  6. §5, act: SwitchServer(s id) → b and Invoke(s id) → b on io.github.diogochaves.omaseed.Status, fire-and-forget like the others. Menu ids: add, alt-speed, stop-all, start-all, settings, quit, server:<id>.
  7. Q7: the heartbeat and trayIconMode unchanged; Settings shows them as one choice (D25).
  8. §8: one more build issue: the shared menu (app, tray, status, bus) and the popup's ⋯ and ▾ (plugin).

In the app, the menu is one model in integration/ (BarMenu: rows and invoke(id)). Tray builds its QMenu from it, StatusWriter writes it, StatusBus calls invoke. A row added once shows in both. The widget draws menu as it comes, so it never has to learn a new row.

12 · building it

What changes, if the recommendations stand

core and app

  • Last seen, per server (D5 a): state.json gains servers.<id>.lastSeen = {torrents, at, error}, written on each sync of the current server and on a failure. No requests to other servers.
  • App.serverList roles lastCount, lastSeenText, lastError, isCurrent; one App.switchServer(id) that the rail, S1, the tray, : and Settings all call (setDefaultServer under it).
  • A sign-in failure gets its own word in serverLine and stops the automatic retry; the footer's "last sync" falls back to "not synced yet".
  • Tray: a server block, rebuilt on serverChanged, hidden with fewer than two servers.
  • new core/ErrorWords (D23), with a QtTest per row of §10's table.
  • new integration/BarMenu (D24): one model the tray, StatusWriter (servers, menu) and StatusBus (SwitchServer, Invoke) share.

views and keys

  • Rail: a serversOnly mode; MainView shows the rail when there are 2+ servers in every state but the log face, and turns serversOnly on while there is no list.
  • new The servers leave the rail's Flickable for a pinned RailServers under it (D12, D16–D18): the band, the dots, folding remembered app-wide, the 5-row rule.
  • new Kit/Notice (D21) for the window, the sheets and the footer's details; one server: no chip, no "server: NAME", ctrl+s's footer answer (D19, D20); Settings › Appearance's "In the bar" (D25).
  • new The plugin: ⋯ in the popup head, the server line's ▾, the menu drawn as written, ctrl+. and ctrl+s (docs/20 §3).
  • Views/ServerPalette.qml, the size of SortPalette; Kit/Hero: a serverClickable flag, ▾, hover fill.
  • EmptyState: the server's name and the ctrl+s row with 2+ servers; a "no list" variant for O3 and O4.
  • Keymap: ctrl+s in "global", a help row, "switch server…" and per-server rows in :, all in offlineActions. DisconnectedBanner: "switch server".
  • AddSheet (#72): the head's server chip with 2+ servers, ctrl+s in the "add" area, a serverChanged handler that keeps the typed fields and re-reads save path, free space and the library match, and "add when back" (the request held until serverBack).
